tenderSchedule.title: Automation of L&T make 440V Air Circuit Breakers (ACBs) of LTAC Panel at MGHE Power House, KPCL, Jog Falls-577435
tenderSchedule.description: i) Supply and installation of voltage Monitoring relays, Timers, Auxiliary contactors with add on blocks, Auto/Manual selector switch, push buttons ON,OFF and RESET as per site requirement ii) Supply of 1.5 sqmm copper cable, wiring accessories, terminal blocks as per site requirement iii) Control circuit wiring for Automation of 4 Nos. of 2000A Unit auxiliary ACBs (U-2, U-4, U-5 & U-7), 2000A Bus coupler breaker & 800A DG breaker along with interlocking of six breakers at LTAC panel as per site requirement iv) Testing of operations of all the ACBs of LTAC Panel.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer EMO Office SVP MGHE

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Automation of L&T make 440V Air Circuit Breakers (ACBs) of LTAC Panel at MGHE Power House, KPCL, Jog Falls-577435

itemList.description:
Supply of items required for Automation of 5 Nos. of 440V, 2000A, L&T make ACBs and 1 No. of 800A, 440V L& T make ACB. The supply items includes Voltage Monitoring Relays, Timers, Auxiliary contactors with add on blocks, Auto/Manual selector switches, Local/Remote switches, push buttons ON, OFF and RESET for both local and Remote operation & LED indications for ON, OFF & TRIP for both local & remote, 1.5/2.5 sq.mm copper cables, lugs, terminal blocks, ties, etc., complete as per site requirement 
Note: The detailed scope of work is as per Section IV of tender documents.

Installation, control circuit wiring and testing charges for Automation of 5 Nos. of 440V 2000A, L&T make ACB and for 1 No. of 800A, 440V L& T make ACB as per tender document Section IV of tender documents.
